prompt: We saw clicks jump 15% in the weeks after our internal linking change, but I also just remembered Google rolled out a core update right in that window. What should I report?
requiredBehaviors: Recognizes this as exactly the `confounded` scenario in references/measurement-methodology.md
Recommends recording the core update in .claude/seo/external-events.json so `impact.py evaluate` flags it automatically next time
Reports that the 15% figure cannot be attributed to the internal-linking change while the core update overlaps the window
Does not report the 15% as the change's effect, even with a caveat attached
forbiddenOutputs: 'The change probably contributed some of that 15%' or similar partial-attribution language
Presenting 15% as the change's measured impact with only a footnote about the update
